messages:
Elena (CEO): Morning all — quick weekly sketch of where we are and what I want us focused on for the next 7 days. High level: drive reliability, finish Private GA checklist, and keep unit economics improving. Key bullets below.

Elena (CEO): 1) Reliability — last week we had two short tail-severity incidents in EU that exposed a routing fallback gap. P99 for text-gen rose ~120ms for ~45min. We fixed the routing rule but need a permanent guard. I want a short plan from Eng by EOD Thurs.

Elena (CEO): 2) Private GA — we are on track for the customer pilot next Tue; Product and Security please confirm the docs checklist + attestation flow. This is priority for the sales inbound pipeline.

Elena (CEO): 3) Costs — overall hosted token cost improved 6% month-over-month thanks to quantization + caching updates. Still pushing to another 8% reduction without increasing latency. Ops, give a list of micro-ops to test.

Priya (Head of Product): Noted on GA. We completed the GDPR review yesterday and uploaded the final playbook to Confluence. Will share the link in #product shortly. Also adding a lightweight runbook for on-prem install issues.

Mark (VP Eng): On the routing fallback gap — we've got an action: add a cross-region fallback threshold and a canary for the new selector. I'll own the PR, aiming for rollout by Friday. Also starting a 48-hour soak for the new batcher kernel.

Mark (VP Eng): Current infra metrics: p50 latency 25ms, p95 120ms, p99 340ms for hosted text-gen (seq len 512). EU incident pushed p99 to ~460ms for the window. Dedicated pools stable at p99 ~280ms.

Sam (Head of Customer Success): FYI — two pilot prospects (Fintech A, HealthTech B) asked for Private GA dates and a security FAQ. Sharing standard FAQ now. They both care about HSM/KMS integrations.

Jon (CFO): Good progress on cost. Reminder: we need an updated 90-day forecast showing Dedicated revenue cadence if both pilots convert. Revenue ops, please sync with Sales by Tuesday.

deploy-bot: deploy completed: release/optimize-cache v2.4 -> production at 2025-04-21T10:34:12Z :rocket: (no errors).

Elena (CEO): Two quick policy notes: 1) Incident notification change — for Sev2+ we now auto-page oncall and notify execs; see #eng-oncall for details. 2) Travel policy tweak: domestic travel <$750 pre-approved by manager, anything above needs People Ops pre-clear.

Priya (Head of Product): Action items captured: product/infra to share GA checklist (by Wed), Mark to open PR for fallback (by Fri), Ops to propose 3 cost experiments (by Mon).

Mark (VP Eng): Acknowledged. Will post the PR link and rollout plan in #eng-runtime.

Sam (Head of Customer Success): I'll coordinate pilot comms and the security FAQ with the customers.

Elena (CEO): Thanks team — appreciate the focus. Two small reminders: keep exec-visibility on any customer-impacting regressions, and if anything blocks GA, @me directly. :eyes:

Priya (Head of Product): :thumbsup:

Mark (VP Eng): :thumbsup:

Sam (Head of Customer Success): Thanks, team!

Jon (CFO): Thanks.

Elena (CEO): End of update.
